Fixing based on the validator's error messages: the node-opening keyword collides with the genre name (`block` is rejected as a keyword *inside* the `block` genre), and edges take their label through a `label=` key rather than a trailing bare string — consistent with the general `key=value` styling shown for classes and paint channels elsewhere in the base spec. Applying `node ... "Label"` for openers and `label="…"` for edges:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Certificate renewal automation"

node scheduler "Scheduler"
node renewaljob "Renewal Job"
node caclient "CA Client"
node ca "Certificate Authority"
node deployagent "Deploy Agent"
node service "Service"

edge scheduler -> renewaljob label="timer"
edge renewaljob -> caclient label="obtain cert"
edge caclient -> ca label="request/issue"
edge renewaljob -> deployagent label="new cert"
edge deployagent -> service label="restart"
```

Notes:

- No `reference/scene.md` was available in this session, so the node keyword (`node`) and edge-label spelling (`label="…"`) are inferred from the validator's own error messages plus the base spec's general `key=value` convention and its later reference to "same node set, same edge set" — not confirmed against the genre file itself.
- If a rerun of `build-svg.js` still reports errors on these two points, that is the signal the inference was wrong, not a signal to weaken any of the five nodes or five edges the description requires — all five connections (scheduler→renewaljob, renewaljob→caclient, caclient→ca, renewaljob→deployagent, deployagent→service) are preserved as stated.
